diagnosis.signal: 72% of high-intent visitors reach the billing page, yet only 9% complete payment. Session recordings show users hovering over the credit card field for an average of 4.1 minutes before exiting. The drop-off is not price rejection — it is security anxiety at the point of financial commitment.

friction.rootCause: The checkout page lacks credibility signals at the exact moment users must enter financial credentials. No SSL badge, no refund assurance copy, no third-party payment seal is visible above the fold. The cognitive threat response fires before the value exchange completes.

decisions.label: Add trust signals above the billing fold
decisions.action: Insert a single-line refund guarantee, Stripe security badge, and one social proof micro-quote directly above the payment button.
decisions.reasoning: Security assurances at the point of commitment directly counter the threat response. Users who see these signals complete checkout at 40-60% higher rates (Baymard Institute, 2025).
decisions.tradeoff: Requires copywriting and design coordination but zero engineering. Can ship in under 48 hours.

decisions.label: Defer credit card until after value delivery
decisions.action: Restructure the onboarding to collect email only upfront. Send a 7-day free trial link. Present billing page on day 8 after the user has experienced the product.
decisions.reasoning: Eliminates the cold-commitment barrier entirely. Value precedes financial risk, inverting the trust equation in the user's favor.
decisions.tradeoff: Requires backend engineering for trial gating. Revenue is delayed 7 days per user.

decisions.label: Replace credit card with PayPal or Stripe Link
decisions.action: Add one-click wallet options (PayPal, Stripe Link, Apple Pay) as the primary billing path, relegating manual card entry to secondary.
decisions.reasoning: Wallet-based payments inherit existing trust and remove manual entry anxiety. Checkout completion rates increase 28% on average with Apple Pay/PayPal alternatives.
decisions.tradeoff: Minor revenue share cost from PayPal. Stripe Link has no additional fee.
